General

Cookie Info & Loading
Teddy bears! Let's play together!* Heh heh! You thought I was a doll too, didn't you?*
Toy friends! Follow my lead!* Let's make a snowman that looks just like the winner!

Time really flies when you play in this place! You REALLY like this toy, don't you?
Let's show the snowman we made to the winner when they come out here! It's the first snow! Let's have a snow fight with my toy friends!

I hope it snows REALLY much!

The snow looks just like flowers! I'm gonna make the best snowman there is!
